inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted-average count from the H1 FY2026 interim EPS note (basic 1,699.5m + 18.5m treasury-method dilution from 12.9m RSUs and 16.6m STAR-market restricted shares at RMB6.65-6.95). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; no non-SBC issuance is modelled. The STAR-market raise (2022) and the IPO (2020) are already in the count.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow statement, 'Share-based payment expenses' RMB69,606k (9969.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:7077); equity-award taxes nil (no net-share settlement). FY2024 was a RMB10,792k CREDIT (forfeiture reversal), which is why the CSV shows -10.8. H1 FY2026 charge RMB56,699k = 5.0% of revenue, so the forward path starts above the FY2025 2.9%.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1744 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-23T21:25Z. Direction check: USD/CNY 6.67 and USD/HKD ~7.83 give 7.83/6.67 = 1.174, consistent. The STAR-market twin 688428.SS trades at RMB26.60 (2026-10-23) = HK$31.2 against HK$11.77 for the H share: a ~2.65x A/H premium, so the dual listing cannot serve as a parity check on the rate; it is not evidence of a direction error. All per-share values are computed in RMB and converted at 1.1744; the unsuffixed intrinsic values are in HKD to match current_price.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T08:08:08Z regular HKEX close (Yahoo chart API); 52-week range 9.65-16.20
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB-denominated flows discounted at an RMB-built rate: 10-year China government bond ~1.8%, China equity risk premium ~6.5%, beta ~1.25 for a single-franchise commercial-stage biotech -> cost of equity ~9.9%, rounded to 10.0%. Net cash, so WACC = cost of equity. The same 10% is used in all three scenarios: pipeline, NRDL/VBP and concentration risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate (charge risk once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): leases as operating cost. Lease principal (RMB32.0m FY2025) plus lease interest (RMB1.6m) are charged inside the flows via lease_cost_pct_path (1.4% of FY2025 revenue, sliding to 0.6% as revenue scales), and lease liabilities (RMB29.2m at 30 June 2026) are EXCLUDED from total_debt. da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: 118.4 total less ~33 ROU = ~85m = 3.6%; H1 FY2026: 42.2/1,137 = 3.7%) so EBIT for cash tax does not charge the lease twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests (RMB15.7m at 30 June 2026, share of profit RMB1.7m FY2025) are immaterial; flows are modelled on a consolidated basis and the NCI stock is deducted once in equity_bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (10-year explicit build, margins still ramping) with the non-US adaptations: RMB flows vs HKD quote, leases as operating cost, NCI in the bridge, excluded investment income matched by its source assets in the bridge. Routed as an operating company (commercial-stage pharma with two marketed products and a profitable FY2025); not a cash shell, not a pre-revenue biotech. First valuation of this ticker. NET CASH: total_debt 2,680.2 = interest-bearing bank borrowings 1,872.0 (890.5 current + 981.5 non-current) + Beijing Changxin long-term payable 331.9 + Guangzhou Kaide other current liability 476.3, the three items the company itself counts in 'total indebtedness' (RMB2,709.4m incl. 29.2 leases, excluded here under treatment B). cash 8,412.4 = cash and bank balances 6,310.1 (incl. 1,465.5 time deposits >3 months) + other financial assets 2,102.3 (bank CDs, fixed-coupon notes and structured deposits; 2,041.0 current + 61.4 non-current); the company's own 'cash and related accounts' is 8,430.5 incl. interest receivable. Net cash 5,732.2 = RMB3.34/share = HK$3.92/share, a third of the market price. INVESTMENT INCOME: FY2025 income-statement interest income 119.7m plus wealth-management product income 58.5m (178.2m total, 7.5% of revenue) is EXCLUDED from every projected EBITDA margin because the whole pile is in the bridge; only 36.0m of that was inside reported OCF ('Interest received'; the remaining 120.5m sits in investing activities), so interest_income = 36.0 is what is deducted from reported_fcf to reach last_fcf. CSV EBITDA (828.2m FY2025 = 34.9% margin; H1 FY2026 334.8m = 29.4%) INCLUDES investment and FX income; the operating EBITDA the margin path starts from is ~27.4% FY2025 and ~20.5% H1 FY2026. REVENUE BASE: base_revenue is reported FY2025 revenue 2,374.9m, of which drug sales 1,442.4m (+43.4%) and collaboration revenue 932.5m -- the Zenas upfront (5m ZBIO shares recognised at 701.7m, non-cash, plus ~US$35m cash) and the Prolium upfront. Year-1 growth of 13.5% is NOT a drug-sales growth rate: it is drug sales +36% (guidance >35%) plus the 14 Aug 2026 Zenas near-term milestone (US$25m cash + 2m ZBIO shares, ~RMB520m) replacing the FY2025 upfront, and year 2 is +2% because that milestone does not repeat while drug sales grow ~25%. The 2m milestone shares are treated as cash-equivalent in year 1 (ZBIO is a liquid Nasdaq listing). SBC: expensed in the flows at 4.5% of revenue falling to 2.5%; share count flat; buybacks small (RMB16.7m FY2025, nil H1 FY2026) so the flat count is mostly a modelling convention, not yet funded by repurchases. CASH TAX: FY2025 cash tax RMB0.09m on PBT 655.7m. Unrecognised tax losses of RMB3,374.5m (mainland, expiring over 1-10 years under HNTE rules) plus RMB585.0m (other jurisdictions, indefinite), a 15% HNTE rate and the 200% R&D super-deduction (R&D 951.6m = 40% of FY2025 revenue; the super-deduction alone was worth RMB130m of tax in FY2025) keep cash tax near zero for 2-3 years; the path then ramps to 12% of EBIT by year 8, which is deliberately above the mechanical ~5% so that US-taxed licensing income at InnoCare US and PRC policy change are covered. ZENAS STAKE: 5m ZBIO shares (7.9%) designated FVOCI, RMB864.3m at 30 June 2026; marked in equity_bridge at the valuation date (US$26.87 x 5m x 6.6697 = RMB896.1m) less ~24% tax on the gain above the RMB666.8m cost base = RMB840.1m. Its fair-value movements are not in the flows. H1 FY2026 owner FCF was -40.1m (reported 42.3 - SBC 56.7 - interest received 25.7): the drug business is at roughly owner-FCF breakeven today; the value is in the ramp, which is why the bear weight is 30%.

equity_bridge.item: Zenas BioPharma 5.0m shares (FVOCI) at ZBIO US$26.87 x USD/CNY 6.6697, net of ~24% tax on gain over RMB666.8m cost
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim note 12 (RMB864.3m at 30 June 2026); ZBIO and USDCNY=X from Yahoo 2026-10-23
FY2025 annual report, RMB24.8m at 31 December 2025

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2025-FY2030 total revenue CAGR (drug sales ~24% CAGR plus flat-to-lumpy licensing); historical CAGRs are not usable as a forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (0.6% 3yr; 20% 5yr, raise-driven) diverges >30% from revenue CAGR (56% 3yr) -- expected for a company that was loss-making until FY2025. The 5yr revenue CAGR compounds from a RMB1.4m pre-launch base and the 3yr figure is inflated by the FY2025 Zenas upfront; drug-sales CAGRs (36.5% 3yr, 61.0% 4yr) are the meaningful series. EPS and FCF CAGRs are null because the base years are negative.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest received inside OCF, applied to the whole history (FY2024 SBC was a RMB10.8m credit). The series is negative in every year: reported FCF 'growth' is undefined and the FY2025 reported FCF of +13.8m is itself only positive because 701.7m of revenue was received in Zenas shares that never passed through cash.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 drug sales +36% (guidance >35%; H1 +43%) to ~1.96bn plus ~RMB740m collaboration (H1 219m + Aug-2026 Zenas milestone ~520m) = ~2.70bn. FY2027 +2%: drug sales +25% to ~2.45bn but licensing falls back to ~300m (remaining Zenas near-term cash, Prolium milestones). FY2028-30 +20/19/16%: 1L CLL/SLL and ITP volume, tafasitamab and zurletrectinib full ramps, mesutoclax launch ~2028, SLE from ~2029. Deceleration to 5% by 2035 (total revenue ~7.3bn, drug sales ~6.5bn, royalties/milestones ~0.85bn).
base.margin_rationale: Operating EBITDA ex investment income: FY2025 27.4%, H1 FY2026 20.5% (drug business ~breakeven; R&D 44% of revenue). Year 1 28% carries the 100%-margin Zenas milestone; year 2 21% as it drops out and R&D keeps growing with five+ registrational programmes; then operating leverage as R&D falls from ~40% to ~22% of revenue and SG&A from ~30% to ~18%, reaching 36% -- below big-pharma 40%+ because China NRDL pricing and a still-heavy R&D load are structural.
base.wc_rationale: Negative capture: hospital receivables ~110 days (RMB550m on ~1.8bn annualised drug sales) plus inventory (199m) exceed trade payables (181m); growth consumes ~20 cents of working capital per incremental RMB of revenue (licensing revenue needs none, which is why it is not 30%+).
base.tax_rationale: See inputs.notes: ~RMB4.0bn unrecognised tax losses, HNTE 15% rate, 200% R&D super-deduction; FY2025 cash tax was 0.01% of PBT.

bull.growth_rationale: Revenue ~9.8bn by 2035 (15% CAGR): SLE Phase III and ITP succeed and orelabrutinib becomes a multi-indication autoimmune franchise in China; mesutoclax + orelabrutinib combination wins 1L CLL/SLL share from zanubrutinib; TYK2 (soficitinib, ICP-488) launches 2028-29; Zenas MS Phase III succeeds with high-teens royalties from ~2031 and milestone payments against the >US$2bn headline; ADC platform delivers a further out-licence.
bull.margin_rationale: 42% mature EBITDA: royalty and milestone income at ~100% margin reaches ~15% of revenue and R&D intensity falls to ~20% as partners fund ex-China trials.

bear.growth_rationale: Revenue ~3.9bn by 2035 (5% CAGR): FY2026 still lands near guidance (+10% total with the Aug-2026 milestone), then a VBP/NRDL price reset on the BTK class (as zanubrutinib absorbed after the 7th national batch) and share loss to pirtobrutinib/zanubrutinib cap orelabrutinib at ~2.5bn; SLE Phase III fails, Zenas MS fails so no royalties, mesutoclax adds only modestly; licensing income dries up after the contracted near-term Zenas cash.
bear.margin_rationale: 22% mature EBITDA: R&D is cut only slowly (management keeps funding the pipeline into disappointing readouts), gross margin erodes with price cuts, and the 15x terminal cap reflects a China specialty-pharma multiple with no growth premium.

scenario_narratives.base: Orelabrutinib's four NRDL-reimbursed indications plus 1L CLL/SLL and ITP grow drug sales ~25-35% a year through 2028, tafasitamab and zurletrectinib add a second and third product, and mesutoclax launches around 2028, taking drug sales to ~RMB6.5bn by 2035. Licensing is lumpy: ~RMB740m in FY2026 (the H1 deliverables plus the August 2026 Zenas milestone of US$25m and 2m ZBIO shares), then ~300-850m a year of contracted near-term cash, development milestones and eventually MS royalties. R&D falls from 40% to ~22% of revenue and EBITDA matures at 36%. Cash tax stays near zero for three years on RMB4bn of tax losses and the R&D super-deduction, ramping to 12%. The axes that move this case are NRDL pricing at each renewal, the SLE and MS Phase III readouts, and whether the second-mover BTK franchise holds share against zanubrutinib and pirtobrutinib.
scenario_narratives.bull: Autoimmune indications turn orelabrutinib from an oncology drug into a franchise (ITP approval 2027, SLE 2029), mesutoclax and the TYK2 pair reach the market on schedule, and Zenas' MS programme succeeds, delivering milestones against the >US$2bn headline and high-teens royalties from ~2031. Revenue compounds at 15% to ~RMB9.8bn and the royalty mix lifts mature EBITDA to 42%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The BTK class takes a VBP-style price reset in China and pirtobrutinib/zanubrutinib take 1L share, so orelabrutinib plateaus near RMB2.5bn; SLE and MS Phase IIIs fail, so neither the autoimmune expansion nor Zenas royalties arrive; licensing income stops after the contracted Zenas near-term cash. R&D is cut too slowly, EBITDA matures at 22% on ~RMB3.9bn of revenue, and most of the equity value is the RMB5.7bn of net cash plus the Zenas stake.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: revenue concentration in one molecule, a single regulator (NRDL/VBP) setting that molecule's price, the drug business at owner-FCF breakeven today, and a thesis that rests on several binary readouts. Bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs SLE, MS (via Zenas), mesutoclax and TYK2 to go right independently. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: InnoCare is valued as an operating pharma on a strict owner-FCF basis, with the one-off character of FY2025 handled explicitly rather than by carrying the reported numbers forward. FY2025 revenue of RMB2,374.9m includes RMB932.5m of licensing revenue, RMB701.7m of which was received as Zenas shares, not cash; FY2025 reported FCF of +13.8m becomes -91.8m once SBC and the interest received inside OCF are stripped, and H1 FY2026 owner FCF was -40.1m. The model therefore compounds from the reported FY2025 base but (i) sets year-1 growth at 13.5% and year-2 at 2% so that the August 2026 Zenas milestone replaces, and then drops out after, the FY2025 upfront while drug sales grow 36% then 25%; (ii) starts the EBITDA margin from the OPERATING figure (ex RMB178m of interest and wealth-management income, which belongs to the RMB8.4bn cash pile already in the bridge), 28% in year 1 falling to 21% in year 2 before operating leverage takes it to 36%; and (iii) charges 20% of each year's revenue increase as working capital because China hospital receivables run ~110 days. SBC is expensed (4.5% falling to 2.5% of revenue) and the count held flat at the diluted 1,718.0m; leases are an operating cost and excluded from debt; cash tax ramps from zero over the RMB4bn of unrecognised tax losses and the R&D super-deduction. Net cash of RMB5.7bn (bank borrowings, the Changxin and Guangzhou Kaide construction liabilities all counted as debt) and the Zenas stake marked at the valuation date net of tax are added to enterprise value. Values are built in RMB and converted to HKD at 1.1744. A third of the H-share price is net cash; the remainder prices the ramp of the drug franchise, so the scenario weights (30/50/20) matter more here than the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: NRDL renewal or a VBP-style procurement cut on the BTK class resetting orelabrutinib pricing (the bear case's main axis)
Share loss in 1L CLL/SLL to zanubrutinib and pirtobrutinib; a safety signal on the single molecule that is ~90% of drug sales
Binary Phase III readouts: SLE (orelabrutinib), MS (Zenas), mesutoclax registrational trials, soficitinib AD and ICP-488 psoriasis

Licensing revenue is lumpy and partly share-settled; the model treats the Aug-2026 2m ZBIO milestone shares as cash-equivalent and the 5m-share stake at a volatile Nasdaq mark (ZBIO 52-week range is wide)
Cash-tax ramp assumes the HNTE 15% rate and the 200% R&D super-deduction persist; US tax on InnoCare US licensing income could raise the terminal rate above 12%
A/H premium of ~2.65x: the H-share valuation here is on fundamentals, not on convergence to the STAR-market price
R&D intensity: the margin ramp needs R&D to fall from 40% to ~22% of revenue; a company that keeps spending at 35%+ lands near the bear margins even on base revenue
